components.description: Existing canonical default variant from controls.css; CSS variables inherit the active theme.

rules.name: The Semantic Theme Rule
rules.body: Use shared semantic roles for new UI so foregrounds, surfaces and interaction states change together across light and dark modes.

rules.name: The Tailwind First Rule
rules.body: Express new feature layout, typography, responsive behavior, hover, focus and motion directly with Tailwind utilities in TSX. Keep semantic tokens and canonical control foundations in their existing shared stylesheets; do not add feature stylesheets when utilities express the design. The browser root View Transition pseudo-element rules are the approved shared CSS exception for the theme reveal.

narrative.overview: The existing blue PixelVault identity frames an information-rich community and lending workspace. Manrope, cool white or navy surfaces, and thin-ink isometric artwork remain the incumbent visual world. The connected-shell revision expands usable space and makes displayed podium positions distinct while preserving factual amounts, visible XP and member-controlled sharing.
keyCharacteristics: Permanent blue P/keyhole identity and original derivative artwork.
Semantic light/dark working surfaces with restrained borders and interaction feedback.
Responsive navigation, in-place achievement details and factual social counts.
dos: **Do** preserve the blue PixelVault identity and use shared semantic light/dark roles.
**Do** use the recorded shell dimensions, main padding and header area switch for ordinary connected surfaces; agreement-room detail uses the dedicated viewport layout described above.
**Do** keep lending aggregates consent-controlled, exact amounts static, XP ties visible and badge overflow factual.
**Do** offer badge criteria and earned dates in place through canonical controls.
donts: **Don't** use podium colors or likes to imply trust, repayment ability or guaranteed funding.
**Don't** fabricate badge counts, activity or reputation to fill a composition.
**Don't** treat static theme captures as proof of animation behavior or historical checks as current validation.
**Don't** inherit unrelated legacy hard-coded styling or craft-floor defects as new system rules.
